$description: Token usage policy for generators. rawValueRestrictions keys are EXACTLY the category keys of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json, so extraction/verify_all.py check [k] can resolve one against the other and fails if either side is renamed.

enforcementLegend.enforced: A script fails the run if violated; `enforcedBy` names it. Every `enforced` entry below is implemented in extraction/verify_all.py check [k] and exercised by extraction/prove_drift.py.
enforcementLegend.convention: A documented rule that NO script checks. Never describe a convention rule as validated.

enforced.rule: every $ref / $refDark / $refLight / resolvesTo points at an existing token id
tokens/themes/light.json AND tokens/themes/dark.json each resolve every semantic id, and nothing else
every id in a primitive/component/section contract's `tokens` array exists

every foundation colour literal really appears in src/styles/fourmula-base.css, src/styles/fourmula-head.css, src/components/Footer.jsx or public/motion/*.js (WARN-skipped when the source project is not beside this package)
every styleTokens id exists in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json
enforced.enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_UNKNOWN (graph rule), exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py

enforced.rule: no raw hex / rgb / hsl / named colour in styleTokens
enforced.enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_RAW_COLOR (graph rule), exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py

enforced.rule: no raw px / rem / % / vw / calc length in styleTokens; only space.* and radius.* roles
enforced.enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING (graph rule), exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py

enforced.rule: fontFamily is font.body only; no raw family name
enforced.enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT (graph rule), exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py

enforced.rule: no id that only the other palette resolves; the theme must be schema-validated
enforced.enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH (graph rule), exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py

enforced.rule: each slot takes its own semantic family; foundation / component / layout ids and vendor.cookie-* outside the consent UI are rejected
enforced.enforcedBy: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_CATEGORY_MISMATCH (graph rule), exercised by schema/tests/adversarial_test.py

enforced.rule: token-catalog.json, token-policy.json and motion-patterns.json are registered in registry.manifest.json and every catalog category equals its sourceFile's ids

convention: Reference semantic roles, not foundation ids
No raw hex, px, rem or ms in generated output
Never treat .body.dark as the dark theme - it is the LIGHT palette and it is the default
Never convert a rem token to px without applying the fluid root font-size formula
No box-shadow: the site-authored stylesheet has none
Never reuse a vendor.cookie-* colour for brand UI

color.rule: Never write a raw colour. Reference a semantic role. Themed roles resolve per palette; literal roles are palette-independent. #3898ec, #ddd, #ccc, #222, #333, #fafafa, #c8c8c8, #999, #5d6c7b and #e2e2e2 are Webflow framework reset values and are NOT tokens.
color.enforcedBy: TOKEN_RAW_COLOR, TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH, TOKEN_CATEGORY_MISMATCH in schema/semantic_validate.py, on PageSpec styleTokens

typography.rule: Only the 16 type steps through their semantic roles. No raw font-size, line-height or font-family. The Webflow reset sizes 38/32/24/18/14/12px are NOT part of the scale.
typography.enforcedBy: TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT, TOKEN_UNKNOWN, TOKEN_CATEGORY_MISMATCH in schema/semantic_validate.py, on PageSpec styleTokens

spacing.rule: Only the 47 measured rem steps (35 positive, 12 negative) through their semantic roles. The scale is 0.25rem-based with documented hand-tuned outliers.
spacing.enforcedBy: TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING, TOKEN_CATEGORY_MISMATCH in schema/semantic_validate.py, on PageSpec styleTokens

radius.rule: Only the 17 measured radius values. radius.md (3rem) and radius.pill (99rem) dominate.
radius.enforcedBy: TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING, TOKEN_CATEGORY_MISMATCH in schema/semantic_validate.py, on PageSpec styleTokens

breakpoint.rule: Only 991px, 767px and 479px switch layout, plus the single min-width:992px query that flips the hero marquee axis and the two min-width:768px uses. 2560px and 1728px are root-font-size stops ONLY - never use them for layout.

elevation.rule: No box-shadow at all. Only the 10 documented z-index layers and the two inline blur filters.

iconSize.rule: Glyphs are inline SVG at width/height 100%; the viewBox fixes only the aspect ratio and the wrapper's CSS sets the size. Never hard-code a pixel icon size.

motion.rule: Only the closed motion.* vocabulary. Every section node needs a reducedMotionFallback; only the background-video slot may call it `mirrored`.

semanticColor.rule: Semantic colour roles are the API for generators; each must resolve to a foundation token in BOTH tokens/themes/light.json and tokens/themes/dark.json.

semanticTypography.rule: Reference the semantic type roles, which resolve to the 16 fluid steps.

semanticShapeSpace.rule: Reference the semantic radius and spacing roles.

component.rule: Component tokens are owned by component and section contracts. A PageSpec never sets one.

layout.rule: Structural decisions come from layout.* only. Note layout.dots-field.width (103rem) is the dot grid's own width, NOT a content max-width.

overrides.statement: Revision 1.1 adds ONE optional, closed node-level field, styleTokens {surface, text, accent, border, typography, fontFamily, spacing, radius}, whose values are token REFERENCES only. It exists so that the token policy is machine-enforceable on a PageSpec (the approval requirement asks the validator to reject unknown tokens, raw colours, arbitrary spacing, unsupported fonts and invalid theme/token combinations). Styling is still owned by the section and component contracts; styleTokens can only select an existing semantic role, never a value. A free-form `tokens` key stays rejected by the schema at page and node level.
overrides.history: Up to 1.0.0 a PageSpec carried no token field at all and token safety was tested only by drift injection; that layer is kept.

themeModel.invertedDetail: .body = DARK values, .body.dark = LIGHT values, shipped <body class="body dark"> => the default rendered theme is LIGHT.
themeModel.pageField: PageSpec `theme` (optional, enum light|dark, default light) - validated against styleTokens by TOKEN_THEME_MISMATCH.
